inlineSql: SELECT name, state_desc from sys.databases GO

Select AC_CODE,Sum(CR_AMT-DR_AMT) as Amount,SUM(CASE WHEN IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN(CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN FINE_WT ELSE -FINE_WT END) ELSE 0 END) as GoldWt,sum(CASE WHEN IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN SIGN = '+' THEN FINE_WT ELSE -FINE_WT END) ELSE 0 END) as SilverWt FROM AC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? ' and ENTRY_TIME < ' ? MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss ? ' ? C ? AND DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY AC_CODE

SELECT BOOK_NAME as BookNameT,CO_BOOK As BookCodeT,BOOK_TYPE AS TypeL,ITM_TYPE AS ItemL,MAIN_BOOK As MainBookL,BOOK_SNAME As BookSNameL,BOOK_INOUT As BookInOutL,USER_EMP_CODE FROM BOOK_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CUR_USE = 'Y' AND DATA_TYPE = 'A' AND MAIN_BOOK = ' ? ' ORDER BY BOOK_NAME

SELECT * FROM COL_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND BOOK_NAME IN ('TAG_IDTL')

Select A.IT_CODE, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN KR_NWT ELSE 0 END) AS TotNetWt,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_AMT+A.KR_OTH_AMT+A.KR_LBR_AMT ELSE 0 END) AS TotAmt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? And A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.TR_TYPE IN ('P','I') GROUP BY A.IT_CODE

Select A.IT_CODE, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) AS TotNetWt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE
UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET AVG_RATE = ? 0.00 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '
UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET AVG_RATE = 0,AVG_NWT = ? TotNetWt ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '

Select A.IT_CODE, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE 0 END) AS TotPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN CASE WHEN KR_COST <> 0 THEN A.KR_COST ELSE A.ITM_AMT+A.KR_OTH_AMT+A.KR_LBR_AMT END ELSE 0 END) AS TotAmt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.TR_TYPE IN ('P','I') GROUP BY A.IT_CODE

Select A.IT_CODE, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) AS TotPcs FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND A.IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? ' AND B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE
UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET PCS_RATE = ? 0.00 ? ,TOT_PCS = ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '
UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET PCS_RATE = 0,TOT_PCS = ? TotPcs ? 0 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '
Select GR_CODE FROM ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY GR_CODE ORDER BY GR_CODE
Select B.IT_CODE,B.AVG_NWT,B.AVG_RATE,PCS_RATE,TOT_PCS FROM ITEM_MAST AS B WHERE B.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.GR_CODE = ' ? GR_CODE ? ' GROUP BY B.IT_CODE,B.AVG_NWT, B.AVG_RATE,PCS_RATE,TOT_PCS
UPDATE GROUP_MAST SET AVG_RATE = ? 0.00 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? 0.000 ? ,TOT_PCS = ? 0 ? ,PCS_RATE = ? 0.00 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND GR_CODE = ' ? GR_CODE ? '
Select TRAD_TYPE FROM ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY TRAD_TYPE ORDER BY TRAD_TYPE
Select B.IT_CODE,B.AVG_NWT,B.AVG_RATE,PCS_RATE,TOT_PCS FROM ITEM_MAST AS B WHERE B.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND B.TRAD_TYPE = ' ? TRAD_TYPE ? ' GROUP BY B.IT_CODE,B.AVG_NWT, B.AVG_RATE,PCS_RATE,TOT_PCS
UPDATE BAL_GR SET AVG_RATE = ? 0.00 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? 0.000 ? ,TOT_PCS = ? 0 ? ,PCS_RATE = ? 0.00 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TRAD_TYPE = ' ? TRAD_TYPE ? '

SELECT B.IT_CODE AS Code ,B.IT_NAME AS Name,B.IT_TYPE As ItType, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_NWT ELSE -A.ITM_NWT END) ELSE 0 END) AS ClNwt, SUM(CASE WHEN A.VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' THEN(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.ITM_FINE ELSE -A.ITM_FINE END) ELSE 0 END) AS ClFine FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? AND B.RATE_TYPE <> 'P'
UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET AVG_TOUCH = ? 0.00 ? ,AVG_FINE = ? ClFine ? 0.000 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? ClNwt ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? Code ? '
UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET AVG_TOUCH = 100,AVG_FINE = ? ClFine ? 0.000 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? ClNwt ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? Code ? '

Select A.IT_CODE, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN KR_NWT ELSE 0 END) AS TotNetWt,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN KR_FINE ELSE 0 END) AS TotFine FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.IT_TYPE IN ('G','S') AND A.KR_FINE <> 0 AND A.ITM_MRP = 0 AND A.TAG_NO <> 'N' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET AVG_TOUCH = ? 0.00 ? ,AVG_FINE = ? 0.000 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '
UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET AVG_TOUCH = 100,AVG_FINE = ? TotNetWt ? 0.000 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? TotNetWt ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '
Select GR_CODE FROM ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_TYPE IN ('G','S') GROUP BY GR_CODE ORDER BY GR_CODE

Select A.IT_CODE,B.AVG_TOUCH, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) AS TotNetWt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.GR_CODE = ' ? GR_CODE ? ' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.ITM_MRP = 0 GROUP BY A.IT_CODE,B.AVG_TOUCH
UPDATE GROUP_MAST SET AVG_TOUCH = ? 0.000 ? ,AVG_FINE = ? 0.000 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND GR_CODE = ' ? GR_CODE ? '
Select TRAD_TYPE FROM ITEM_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_TYPE IN ('G','S') GROUP BY TRAD_TYPE ORDER BY TRAD_TYPE
UPDATE BAL_GR SET AVG_TOUCH = ? 0.000 ? ,AVG_FINE = ? 0.000 ? ,AVG_NWT = ? 0.000 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TRAD_TYPE = ' ? TRAD_TYPE ? '

Select A.IT_CODE, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE 0 END) AS TotPcs,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN KR_COST ELSE 0 END) AS TotAmt FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND (B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' OR A.ITM_MRP <> 0) AND A.KR_COST <> 0 and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' AND A.TR_TYPE IN ('P','I') GROUP BY A.IT_CODE
UPDATE ITEM_MAST SET AVG_RATE = ? 0.00 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND IT_CODE = ' ? IT_CODE ? '

Select A.IT_CODE,B.AVG_RATE, SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_PCS ELSE -ITM_PCS END) AS TotPcs FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' ? AND A.CO_YEAR = ' ? ' AND B.TRAD_TYPE = ' ? TRAD_TYPE ? ' AND (B.RATE_TYPE = 'P' OR A.ITM_MRP <> 0) AND A.ITM_PCS <> 0 and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' GROUP BY A.IT_CODE,B.AVG_RATE
UPDATE BAL_GR SET AVG_AMT = ? 0.00 ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND TRAD_TYPE = ' ? TRAD_TYPE ? '

Select A.IT_CODE,C.MELTING_PRC,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN ITM_NWT ELSE -ITM_NWT END) AS TotNetWt FROM (MAIN_STOCK AS A INNER JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE) LEFT JOIN GROUP_MAST AS C ON B.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND B.GR_CODE = C.GR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ?
